An axle broke this morning. As I was using my Trail-Ready Non-Foils Bundle to repair it, a fracas erupted behind me. A hungry, desperate cougar tried to take advantage of our misfortune it seems. Luckily, I turned and raised the card I was holding high above my head and scared that devil cat away. But not before she managed to pilfer our finest buffalo haunch. Oh well, this is the life of a pioneer.
